title: Turtle of Enlightenment
description: A large sea turtle swims across the frame, its segmented shell depicted as deep blue and teal panels containing multiple small scenes of robed meditative figures in various poses. To the left stands a tall, faded outline of a robed enlightened being with a halo, while a black mound covered in small crawling insects sits below. The background contains soft watercolor washes and circular patterns.
prompt: surreal ink and watercolor painting of a large sea turtle swimming, its shell divided into multiple deep blue and teal hexagonal segments containing miniature scenes of robed monks and enlightened figures meditating on black mounds, a tall faded outline of a haloed robed sage stands to the left, black pile of earth covered in crawling insects at the bottom, soft circular patterns and watercolor washes in the background, mystical symbolic style
